properties.name: MEASURED 2026-10-03: --only-if-present --http ADDR where no design was started served the latent surface on STDIO, not at ADDR — a server started with stdin closed exited at once ("failed to start the latent MCP server … connection closed: initialize request") and nothing ever listened
properties.statement: OBSERVED on main 293f957, scratch folder, isolated HOME: `reflow2-mcp --graph-path .reflow2/graph --only-if-present --http 127.0.0.1:0` with stdin closed exited 1 within 10 s, printing the latent banner and then "Error: failed to start the latent MCP server / Caused by: connection closed: initialize request"; no port was bound (measure-main.log; the_latent_surface_serves_the_transport_asked_and_prepares_the_design_it_starts failed there). EXPECTED: the latent surface at the HTTP address asked for. CAUSE, read in main.rs: the latent branch built LatentService and called .serve(stdio()) whatever transport the command line named — the BL-105 class (an explanation served on a transport nobody listens on). Found while serving the latent surface for --read-only over --http and --serve-shared (item 1c), which needed that branch to honour the transport; fixed in the same change.
